title: RAD: A Read-structure Agnostic Demultiplexer for Single-Cell Long-Read Sequencing and Analysis
abstract: Single-cell long-read sequencing (LRS) techniques enable the analysis of full transcript sequences within a cell. However, LRS introduces computational challenges for parsing information, often necessitating the development of custom workflows to handle complex read layouts, such as split combinatorial barcodes. To address these challenges, we introduce an error-robust, read-structure agnostic demultiplexer (RAD). In RAD, users can easily specify read structure, such as adapter sequence and relative barcode position, and can rapidly extract these elements for each read. RAD implements highly accurate barcode whitelist generation from long-read data alone, without the benefit of short-read support or priors while uniquely avoiding common but previously uncharacterized errors during demultiplexing. RAD's comprehensive barcode error correction protocols allow for more sensitive and precise barcode-read assignments. In synthetic and real-world benchmarks against gold-standard demultiplexers, RAD is faster and achieves better biological discovery capability in downstream gene expression analysis than existing pipelines. We show RAD can be applied to datasets ranging from high-definition long-read spatial transcriptomics to targeted long-read single-cell immune receptor sequencing, making it a powerful and scalable tool for both standard and custom long-read sequencing experiments.
affiliations: Thayer School of Engineering, Dartmouth, Hanover, NH

llm.novelty_zh: 提出与读段结构无关的长读长单细胞条形码解复用方法，并处理此前未被描述的解复用错误。
llm.summary_zh: RAD是一种与读段结构无关的长读长解复用工具，用户可自定义接头序列与条形码位置，仅依靠长读数据即可生成条形码白名单并进行纠错。在合成与真实数据基准中，它比金标准工具更快，并在下游基因表达分析中取得更好的生物学发现能力。
llm.why_it_matters_zh: 为复杂的长读长单细胞与空间测序数据预处理提供了灵活且可扩展的工具。
